information: Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us. All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering. Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. Only **one** guest per competitor will be allowed. Competitors ages 16 and older are encouraged to come alone.
